name: All Ireland Linguistics Olympiad
desc: The All Ireland Linguistics Olympiad (AILO) is a national competition for secondary school students in Ireland. It features accessible but challenging linguistics puzzles that test reasoning, pattern recognition, and language analysis skills.
summary: National olympiad introducing students in Ireland to linguistic problem-solving.

name: Asia Pacific Linguistics Olympiad
desc: The Asia Pacific Linguistics Olympiad (APLO) is a regional linguistics competition for secondary students across the Asia-Pacific region. It features analytical problems involving diverse languages and writing systems, with all required background provided in the statements.
summary: Regional olympiad connecting Asia-Pacific teams through multilingual linguistics problems.

name: Canadian Linguistics Olympiad
desc: The Canadian Linguistics Olympiad (OLCLO) is Canada's national competition in linguistics for secondary students. It uses puzzle-based tasks drawn from many languages and supports preparation for higher-level international contests.
summary: National Canadian linguistics olympiad featuring bilingual and multicultural language puzzles.

name: Hong Kong Linguistics Olympiad
desc: The Hong Kong Linguistics Olympiad (HKLO) is a national competition that introduces students in Hong Kong to linguistics through puzzle-style questions. Participants solve problems based on real language data without requiring prior study of linguistics.
summary: National competition in Hong Kong focused on logical analysis of language data.

name: International Linguistics Olympiad
desc: The International Linguistics Olympiad (IOL) is the premier international competition in linguistics for secondary school students. It has been held annually since 2003, bringing together some of the best young linguists from around the world. Problems at IOL cover a wide variety of languages and linguistic topics, ranging from phonology and morphology to syntax, semantics, and writing systems. No prior knowledge of linguistics or languages other than English is required — all necessary context is provided in each problem.
summary: Premier international competition featuring linguistics problem-solving for secondary students.

name: Japanese Language Olympiad
desc: The Japanese Language Olympiad (JLO) is Japan's national linguistics competition for secondary students. It offers language-analysis problems and serves as a pathway for students preparing for international events such as IOL.
summary: National Japanese olympiad selecting and training students for international linguistics contests.

name: Korean Linguistics Olympiad
desc: The Korean Linguistics Olympiad (KLO) is a national competition in South Korea focused on linguistic reasoning. Students solve structured problems involving grammar, writing systems, and language patterns from around the world.
summary: National Korean linguistics olympiad featuring data-driven problem-solving.

name: Latvian Linguistics Olympiad
desc: The Latvian Linguistics Olympiad (LLO) is Latvia's national contest for students interested in language puzzles and analytical reasoning. It presents problems in diverse languages while providing all needed context in each task.
summary: National Latvian olympiad promoting linguistic thinking among secondary students.

name: Malaysian Computational Linguistics Olympiad
desc: The Malaysian Computational Linguistics Olympiad (MyCLO) is a national competition introducing students in Malaysia to language analysis and formal reasoning. Its tasks highlight the intersection of linguistics, logic, and computation.
summary: National Malaysian olympiad combining linguistics and computational-style reasoning.

name: North American Computational Linguistics Olympiad
desc: The North American Computational Linguistics Olympiad (NACLO) is a regional competition for students in the United States and Canada. It features linguistics and computation-inspired problems that reward logical reasoning over memorization.
summary: Regional olympiad across North America focused on computational linguistics puzzles.

name: Olimpíada Brasileira de Linguística
desc: A Olimpíada Brasileira de Linguística (OBL) é uma competição nacional para estudantes do Brasil interessadas em desafios de linguagem. As provas apresentam dados linguísticos reais e incentivam raciocínio analítico e criatividade.
summary: National Brazilian olympiad bringing linguistics problem-solving to school students.

name: Olimpiada de Lingvistică din România
desc: Olimpiada de Lingvistică din România (OLR) is the Romanian national olympiad in linguistics for school students. Participants solve language puzzles that emphasize inference, pattern recognition, and precise analytical thinking.
summary: National Romanian linguistics olympiad focused on structured language analysis.

name: Online Olympiad in Linguistics
desc: The Online Olympiad in Linguistics (OnLing) is an open international event conducted online. It provides broad access to high-quality linguistics problems for students regardless of geographic location.
summary: Open online linguistics olympiad accessible to participants worldwide.

name: Panini Linguistics Olympiad
desc: The Panini Linguistics Olympiad (PLO) is a national linguistics competition in India for secondary students. It features diverse language puzzles and supports student pathways toward international linguistics olympiads.
summary: National Indian linguistics olympiad introducing students to language science.

name: Taiwan Olympiad in Linguistics
desc: The Taiwan Olympiad in Linguistics (TOL) is Taiwan's national linguistics competition for secondary students. It develops analytical skills through carefully designed problems involving unfamiliar languages and scripts.
summary: National Taiwanese linguistics olympiad for students interested in language puzzles.

name: The Australian Computational and Linguistics Olympiad
desc: The Australian Computational and Linguistics Olympiad (OzCLO) is a national competition for students in Australia. It offers engaging language problems that combine formal reasoning, data analysis, and cross-linguistic insight.
summary: National Australian olympiad blending linguistics with computational thinking.

name: United Kingdom Linguistics Olympiad
desc: The United Kingdom Linguistics Olympiad (UKLO) is a national competition introducing students in the UK to linguistics through puzzle-based tasks. It supports learners at multiple levels, from entry rounds to advanced selections for international competition.
summary: National UK olympiad encouraging linguistic reasoning and problem-solving in schools.
